sloka: सज्जं तिष्ठति रामस्य वालव्यजनमुत्तमम् ।चन्द्रमण्डलसम्काशमातपत्रं च पाण्डुरम् ॥२-१५-१०॥
transliteration: sajjaṁ tiṣṭhati rāmasya vālavyajanamuttamam ।candramaṇḍalasamkāśamātapatraṁ ca pāṇḍuram ॥2-15-10॥

translations.english: A lustrous pale white umbrella resembling the Moon's orb or the pole star was kept in front of the coronation pavilion.
